name: Demo G6: Add Manual Balancing Damper Redline
description: Exercise an add-like redline operation for a modeled MEP accessory using the family-instance evidence contract: create a disposable manual balancing damper/accessory, prove its requested type, prove it is visible, write a deterministic visual gate, and clean it up.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a view, level, and MEP accessory family/type that can be safely placed and deleted.

For the first live smoke, use a low-risk level-hosted or non-hosted damper/accessory symbol. Host-aware duct accessory placement remains a later live hardening step if the active damper family requires duct hosting.
success_criteria: A disposable MEP accessory family instance id is created in the model.
The native create result returns family/type/name evidence matching the requested manual balancing damper/accessory symbol.
The created accessory id is visible in the post-add visible-element inventory.
A deterministic add visual gate artifact passes using post-change capture evidence.
The created accessory is cleaned up with native dry-run and applied delete effect evidence.
failure_criteria: The accessory is not created or is created as a different requested type.
The post-add visible-element inventory does not contain the created accessory id.
The add visual gate artifact is missing or fails.
The cleanup delete dry-run/apply omits the accessory id from effect evidence.
grader_notes: This task is the first explicit MEP accessory add benchmark, targeted at manual balancing damper redlines.
Do not count requestedIds-only cleanup responses as evidence; cleanup must return ids, deletedIds, or impactedIds.
